This row is neither. The failure is a dangling path reference in one repo's runbook that causes a downstream bookkeeping step (recording a failure mode) to be silently skipped. That is real and worth catching, but its blast radius is bounded to hindsight's own record-keeping completeness, not to a false/wrong deliverable reaching a user or a destructive/irreversible action. Nothing here corrupts, deletes, or misrepresents existing state the way a false-green CI check or fabricated verification would — it just means one bug report doesn't get logged until someone notices, which is exactly what this triage process itself is designed to catch.
